name: com.setsuodu.localization
description: Pure Excel-driven localization core for Unity. No ScriptableObject. Key-based. Binary hot-update friendly. UI bindings as Samples (legacy uGUI Text + UI Toolkit with UXML demo).

samples.description: LocText + LocDemo using UnityEngine.UI.Text only. Click language buttons to switch title/button/Label. No TextMeshPro required.
LocLabel + LocDemoUITK + UXML/USS. Click language buttons to switch texts in real-time.
